يجتبين (form VIII)
# يَجْتَبِينَ (yajtabīna) /jad͡ʒ.ta.biː.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَبَى (ijtabā)
# يُجْتَبَيْنَ (yujtabayna) /jud͡ʒ.ta.baj.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَبَى (ijtabā)
